neighbours.label: the relative pronoun (who/that/which) right after 'the same <noun>', opening the clause that identifies the same referent
fire: Critics noted that the same senator who voted for the war now opposes it.
Oddly, the same bakery that won the prize last year closed this spring.
We found the same bacteria which cause the infection living in the soil.
Many fans were surprised that the same coach who built the team was fired.
Ironically, the same tools that protect your privacy can be misused.
In the end, the same voters who elected him turned against him.
Researchers say the same genes that control growth also affect aging.
It was the same teacher who had failed me that later hired me.
